instruction: Audit the implementation of WI-42 (spec.md explains the setup): for each acceptance criterion in WORK-ITEM.md, decide from the code and tests, not from EXEC-RECORD.md's claims, whether it is really met. Do not modify src/ or test/; you may run code. Write AUDIT.json in this directory: a JSON array with one object per criterion, {"ac": "AC1", "status": "met" or "not-met", "evidence": "<file:line, test or command output>"}.
